style: Refine every catalog object toward warm, softly lit cartoon art, consistent with the selected plant reference. Preserve identity, function and original palette family. Keep registered camera, dimensions, roots, sockets, ports, footprints and animation timing. No preferred horizontal light direction for rotatable world sprites; no directional ground shadows. Real 3D render output, editable Blender sources. The source 2D effects remain explicitly identified as 2D. Each object receives fresh independent editor/judge agents. Publish object-by-object to the same PR preview; integrate approved sprites into Godot after catalog review checks. Follow-on design exploration: improve the modeling itself, including forms, proportions, structure, crafted details and decorations. Original part counts and awkward geometry are not constraints. The editor may rebuild native geometry to achieve the better design; the judge should reward useful improvements. Preserve the locked registration, gameplay contact/clearance, animation and modular continuity contract. See modeling-policy.json version2.

qualityCriteria.judgment: Compare actual native exports to fixed target, source, and approved native family. Reward useful modeling improvements. No arbitrary aesthetic numerical pass threshold; no prescribed cosmetic implementation. Missing required evidence means needs_evidence.

aestheticOutcomes.outcome: Quarter turn remains recognizable and feels like substantial crafted conveyor construction. Outer and inner rails, deck and supporting wood have clear, coherent volume in all4facings; purposeful native design improvements are rewarded within functional envelope.

Warm coral rail, cool blue-gray deck and warm honey/brown support form a clear palette hierarchy. Exact approved family connection planes match; curved interior belongs to the same family without muddy, nearly black wood or excessive orange saturation.

Broad soft light and restrained stable highlights separate top/side forms and preserve warm lower-face readability. No horizontal directional bias, cast ground shadow, blown highlight stripe, noisy/glittering shading or unmotivated black patch.

Wood, rail and moving deck read as different purposeful materials. Crafted details support the form, remain stable in motion, and survive representative intended sizes where useful; tiny target marks, exact bolt count, old part count and old weak geometry are not mandatory.

The turning route, moving deck, outer/inner rail separation and supporting mass remain clear at cell128,55,32 and a fractional pitch, including phone-sized current consumer views and contrasting backgrounds.

No materially distracting seam, open black hole, coplanar flicker, disconnected or floating support, clipped form, alpha halo, overhanging connector, support-to-deck intrusion, abrupt normal discontinuity or merged muddy mass in any required facing/frame.

Deck bands visibly travel E-to-N with the original fanned law and synchronized7-period2second loop; rail/wood remain stationary. Both joins to approved directional straights remain continuous in shape, color, highlight, coverage and temporal phase, including loop wrap and fractional sampling.
